protocol.design: 2 genres x complete/challenged packet x3 arms x2 reversed-order repetitions=24 outputs; serial fresh readonly projects
protocol.scope: actual public historical data plus deliberate evaluation perturbations; not observations of new company defects
protocol.review: neutral directories, randomized IDs and path-sanitized full text; development AI, no independent human or strict blind claim
protocol.primary: specific issues identified, corrected/scoped and reflected in decision/exercise; clean false findings; six frozen content criteria, no total quality score
protocol.secondary: wall/host/hook/tool durations, actual injected characters, cumulative/last input and cache, source reads and delivered product

review.reviewer: development AI that also designed the material; not independent or real readers
review.masking: All24 outputs completed before reading. Neutral S directories and exact path removal preceded initial review; R IDs randomized. Mapping file not opened before freeze. Condition might still be inferred from prose; no strict blind claim.

read_counts_scope: Command mentions of each filename, not proof of full reading or comprehension.
limitations: own-project historical data plus deliberate evaluation perturbations; two repeats per task
development AI authored fixtures and review; randomized IDs do not establish independent or strict blind evaluation
no real readers, actual bills, human revision time or population effect established
multiple co-occurring problems do not identify an independent causal effect for each issue
wall time includes host/tools/hooks/model; input includes cache and multiple requests; not a bill
